highlights.title: Photos, camera and files from +
highlights.line: Tap + and pick a screenshot, take a photo or choose a file: it goes with your message.

highlights.title: Copy a whole message
highlights.line: Hold any message's text, then Copy message: all of it, as plain text.

fixes: Closing a sheet no longer leaves the app blank.

highlights.title: This Mac is always there
highlights.line: Mewla for Mac always has this Mac. Nothing to pair, and it comes back by itself.

highlights.title: Drag in browser pictures and screenshots
highlights.line: Drag an image from a browser or a screenshot thumbnail into a message on your Mac.

highlights.title: Pick each agent's model
highlights.line: Tap the model beside Send in a Session to pick another model.

fixes: The terminal opens on the Mac whichever computer the Session is on.
Mewla cleans up what ended Sessions leave behind.
A pairing code someone else got hold of can no longer stand in for your computer.

highlights.title: Drop pictures into a message
highlights.line: Drag an image into the input, or paste a copied one, and it goes with your message.

highlights.title: Mac permissions in one place
highlights.line: Mewla asks for Screen Recording and Accessibility under one name, with a panel to drag in.

highlights.title: Pair your Mac from a link
highlights.line: Open a mewla:// link to pair, and Mewla moves to your local network by itself.

fixes: The counts at the top of the home tray stay on one line in a narrow column.
A Worker whose Work is finished closes its Session by itself; open Work keeps it.
A reply from another computer reaches the Work or Brain chat you have open.
Antigravity Workers wait through rate limits and resume the same conversation when service recovers.
After Windows auto-updates, background Git and agent checks no longer interrupt typing.
Existing terminals and Workers keep running across consecutive Windows updates.
On Mac, switching from the CLI keeps paired phones connected or restores the previous daemon.

highlights.title: Mewla for Mac
highlights.line: Brain and your Sessions in a Mac window, with the cat in the menu bar.

fixes: On Windows, listing available agents no longer runs Cursor commands when Cursor is unused.
Brain chat only shows an outage for the agent serving that chat.
When a Worker's agent stops unexpectedly, Mewla tries to resume its task.
New chat can start with another installed agent when Brain's agent is unavailable.

highlights.title: Calendar shows how your day went
highlights.line: What happens next, what ran and how it went, with the time now marked.

highlights.title: Triggers have their own page
highlights.line: One row shows how many are watching and which needs you. Tap it for the list.

fixes: New session dims an agent this computer does not have, instead of failing after you start.
On a wide screen Brain's row stays selected while a terminal is open.
Sessions on Antigravity now have Chat, approvals, questions and model switching in the app.

highlights.title: Share to Mewla from any app
highlights.line: A picture, file or link from another app lands in Brain's composer, ready to send.

highlights.title: Git turns amber with changes
highlights.line: A Session's Git button turns amber when its folder has changes. Tap it to review.

highlights.title: Finished Work closes itself
highlights.line: Once Brain has the result, done Work leaves your list. Brain reopens it if needed.

try.target: What Work did you close today?

fixes: Antigravity (agy) can run your Workers.
The Telegram channel is gone: Settings has no Channels, and its stored bot token is deleted.
On Android, share files, pictures and links from other apps to Mewla, or open a file with Mewla: they arrive in Brain's composer as attachments.
Screen: a page an agent left on your Mac takes your taps in order and tells you when it can't. A window you are watching keeps the Mac awake.
When Claude or Codex stops answering, Brain says so in one line, and your Work waits instead of failing. It carries on when the answers come back.
Work that is really done closes itself, and you can reopen it. A wait now has an end, and the ones that run past it reach Brain once a day, in one list.
Calendar is the first row of your computer's page, with today's count.
AWS, Google Cloud and Google Workspace are set up the first time you use them, not at start. If setup fails, the card says why.
A scheduled action runs on the model you chose for it.
An open Brain terminal follows Brain after a restart.
On Android, updating from the app opens the installer alone, not a list that also offers Mewla.

highlights.title: Screen works under your finger
highlights.line: Tap to click, drag to scroll, hold for right click; drag the pointer's handle to aim.

fixes: Phone use pastes far less: a long post goes in as one paste, with fewer notices on the phone.
When the phone turns off Phone use's hidden screen, the apps on it come back as they were.
Two Mewla apps on one phone no longer take Phone use from each other on their own.
Screen's first second is black until the picture comes, never a video player's placeholder.
On Android, a wide table or code block in a chat scrolls sideways under your finger again, and table columns no longer run into each other.

highlights.title: Save and share pictures
highlights.line: Hold a picture in a chat, or open it: Save puts it in your photos, Share sends it on.

highlights.title: Brain keeps watch for you
highlights.line: Ask Brain to watch a build or a page: it checks quietly and acts when it changes.

try.target: Tell me when the nightly build on main goes red

highlights.title: Rename, move or merge Work
highlights.line: Open a Work and tap ⋯ to rename it, move it to a project or merge it with another.

fixes: Screen shows the agent's window as live video, and the picture keeps moving on a weak link.
Stop also ends the commands the agent's turn started.
Finished Work closes itself, and the tray is one list of your Work.
Brain can ask you something while a Worker still holds the Work.
A long press on a hostname, link or path in a reply selects it whole.
Phone use types at the cursor like a keyboard, so an app's # and @ pickers open.
A Chinese input method types what you meant on Screen and in the web terminal.

highlights.title: Sign-ins that fit your phone
highlights.line: Take over an agent's page and it fits your phone: tap, type, paste, give back.

fixes: Screen shows one agent at a time, full size, with one switch: Take over or Give back.
Zoomed in on Screen, one finger moves the view; tap twice to zoom, press and hold for right click, double click or drag.
The floating screen is for watching: tap it to open Screen.
Typing fast on Screen sends each letter once, and the keys you need stay above the keyboard.
Slack stays connected: it no longer stops working 12 hours after you connect it.
Google sign-in works in the agents' browser.
Brain always starts: if its earlier conversation can't be resumed, it starts fresh from its notes and tells you.
Codex with an API key or its own model provider now works for Brain.
mewla update restarts Mewla even when it runs in a terminal. A Mewla 0.4.9 or earlier in a terminal needs one Ctrl+C and mewla again first.

highlights.title: Diagrams and files, right in Chat
highlights.line: Flowcharts draw themselves, and every file an agent names opens with a tap.

highlights.title: Back in seconds after switching networks
highlights.line: Wi-Fi to mobile data and back: Mewla reconnects as soon as the network does.

highlights.title: Every update, told in Chat
highlights.line: A line in Brain's chat marks each update. Tap it to see what's new.

fixes: A Brain thread's chat opens on its own messages, at its end or where you were reading.
Windows: mewla update restarts a Mewla installed over SSH.
iPhone and iPad keyboards: Alt+b and Alt+f jump by word in the terminal.

highlights.title: Agent pages survive updates
highlights.line: Restart or update Mewla: the agent's browser keeps every page open.

fixes: A Worker still at work keeps its turn through restarts and long quiet steps.
Work stays open while its Worker still has a page open for you.
A full agent screen makes room for the next agent.
Mewla no longer needs tmux: every Session runs in Mewla's own session host.
On a Mac, Screen shows each agent's browser window live: hold it, type, or stop.

highlights.title: Answer agent questions in Chat
highlights.line: Sign-in, folder trust and first-run choices are cards you tap.

highlights.title: Updates finish by themselves
highlights.line: mewla update restarts Mewla onto the new version. Sessions keep running.

highlights.title: A Worker's page waits for you
highlights.line: A page a Worker opens, like a sign-in, stays in Screen under its name.

fixes: Windows: Brain runs on a Claude Code installed with npm.
When Brain, a Session or a Worker cannot start, Chat says why.
Claude Code or Codex installed for your login shell is found.
A new Claude Session in a folder you pick starts ready.
A message sent right after switching Brain arrives on its own.
Several people on one Windows computer each get their own Mewla.
Windows: a folder path over the length limit says so, and Up a folder works.
